top_signals.headline: Bank Indonesia Holds BI-Rate at 5.75% to Support Rupiah Stability
top_signals.impact: The central bank maintained its benchmark rate amid global uncertainty, balancing growth support with currency stability. Foreign reserves remain robust at $151.8B, providing FX intervention capacity.

top_signals.headline: JCI Index Resilient Above 7,200 as Foreign Flows Turn Positive
top_signals.impact: Jakarta Composite Index maintains strength driven by banking and consumer sectors. Net foreign buying resumed as EM sentiment improves on Fed pivot expectations. YTD performance +2.3%.

top_signals.headline: Indonesia Q3 GDP Grows 5.12% YoY, Beats Consensus Estimates
top_signals.impact: Economic expansion driven by household consumption (+4.9%) and fixed investment (+5.1%). Manufacturing PMI at 52.3 signals continued expansion. Full-year growth projected at 5.05-5.15%.

top_signals.headline: Federal Reserve Signals Potential December Rate Cut Amid Cooling Inflation
top_signals.impact: FOMC minutes suggest committee members see conditions for further easing. Core PCE trending toward 2.5% target. Markets pricing 65% probability of 25bp cut in December.

top_signals.headline: Treasury yields rise as investors await latest producer price inflation data
top_signals.impact: Treasury yields were edged higher as investors awaited the latest producer price inflation print for June.

top_signals.headline: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures extend gains ahead of earnings, wholesale inflation data
top_signals.impact: The focus turns to Wednesday's release of the Producer Price Index and a wave of earnings.

top_signals.headline: Indonesian Rupiah Stabilizes at 15,850/USD on Trade Surplus
top_signals.impact: Currency finds support from continued trade surplus ($10.5B Q3) and BI intervention. Carry trade dynamics remain favorable vs USD. Key resistance at 16,000 level.

top_signals.headline: Indonesian Banks Report Strong NIM Expansion in Q3 Results
top_signals.impact: Major banks (BBCA, BBRI, BMRI) posted 12-15% earnings growth with NIMs expanding to 5.2-5.8%. Loan growth accelerated to 11.5% YoY. NPL ratios stable at 2.1-2.4%.

top_signals.headline: S&P 500 Approaches All-Time High on AI Optimism and Rate Cut Bets
top_signals.impact: Index trading near 6,000 level as tech sector leads. Magnificent 7 stocks contribute 60% of YTD gains. Earnings growth re-accelerating to +8% YoY in Q4.

top_signals.headline: US 10-Year Treasury Yield Falls to 4.35% on Dovish Fed Outlook
top_signals.impact: Bond yields decline as markets reprice Fed trajectory. Real yields at +2.0% remain attractive for fixed income allocations. Duration positioning shifts to neutral.

top_signals.headline: Morgan Stanley posts record quarterly revenue and profit as equities trading surges 69%
top_signals.impact: Like at peers Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan Chase, a massive beat in equities trading drove the quarter's outsized results.

top_signals.headline: New York Fed President Williams says inflation has peaked, rates 'well positioned'
top_signals.impact: Williams cited five reasons why he expects the latest price surge has run its course.

top_signals.headline: China Manufacturing PMI Expands to 51.5, Supporting EM Sentiment
top_signals.impact: Factory activity strengthens on stimulus measures and export recovery. Positive read-through for Asian supply chains and commodity demand. EM currencies rally.

top_signals.headline: Brent Crude Holds at $78/bbl as OPEC+ Maintains Production Discipline
top_signals.impact: Oil prices stabilize on balanced supply-demand outlook. OPEC+ compliance remains high at 95%. Inventory levels normalize. Range-bound trading expected near term.

top_signals.headline: United earnings top estimates but airline expects $6 billion in added fuel costs
top_signals.impact: United reported higher revenue for premium, corporate and no-frills basic economy tickets and higher revenue for both domestic and international trips.

top_signals.headline: UnitedHealth blows past estimates, hikes earnings outlook as it reins in costs
top_signals.impact: The healthcare giant is working to stabilize margins by shrinking membership, exiting unprofitable contracts and pouring $1.5 billion into AI.

top_signals.headline: Watch Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh testify live before Senate banking committee
top_signals.impact: Part of congressionally mandated Capitol Hill appearances for the central bank leader, Warsh spoke Tuesday to the House Financial Services Committee.

top_signals.headline: Stock futures rise on chip stocks bounce, encouraging inflation signs: Live updates
top_signals.impact: S&P 500 futures edged higher Wednesday, led by gains in chipmakers, after a rally fueled by softer-than-expected inflation data.

top_signals.headline: Bank earnings takeaways: From Goldman Sachs' SpaceX IPO fees to JPMorgan's AI job cuts
top_signals.impact: The five banks reported strong revenue from equities trading.

top_signals.headline: Buffett says Trump's pick of Kevin Warsh for Fed chair was 'good choice'
top_signals.impact: Warren Buffett believes Fed Chair Kevin Warsh will do the best job he can.

top_signals.headline: United Airlines shares fall as weak outlook overshadows Q2 earnings beat
top_signals.impact: United Airlines shares dropped after the company issued third-quarter earnings guidance that fell below Wall Street expectations, despite beating analyst estimates for its second-quarter results. top_signals.impact: The Russell 2000 small-cap stock index is up almost 20% this year, its best first half since 1991, and investing experts say the rally can keep running.

top_signals.headline: Iran, US step up attacks, though release of American may signal path to climbdown - Reuters
top_signals.impact: Iran, US step up attacks, though release of American may signal path to climbdown  Reuters

top_signals.headline: Sen. Warren says Trump's CFPB overhaul has cost Americans $26.5 billion
top_signals.impact: Sen. Elizabeth Warren says the Trump administration's rollback of CFPB rules and enforcement has cost Americans up to $26.5 billion so far.

top_signals.headline: GE boosts profit outlook, but stock falls as booming order growth cools
top_signals.impact: GE Aerospace’s stock falls after earnings, again, with recently rapid order-book growth slowing.
